title: director.ai/1
description: data/director/ai.json: the AI's skill numbers (sim/director/ai.gd). Under ADR 0008 the AI plays by the player's rules and gets an outcome only by an input; these numbers say how often it makes that input. One difficulty for now. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore. Every number is a chance from 0 to 1.

pressReact.description: Per defender stance: the chance the AI has an attack request in when it is attacked in that stance (the press: a trade or a counter needs the defender's own request).

beamAnswer.description: The chance the AI answers a beam when it can: with its own signature, or else a heavy blast.

sigPick.description: The chance an AI attack is the signature, with the ki and the cooldown over.
